claims.claim_text: 「它會算出最接近的、分母為 8 的分數，然後以那個比例解碼影像」
claims.evidence: It computes the closest fraction with a denominator of 8 and decodes the image at that scale.
claims.note: Quoted span matches the source sentence; the surrounding claim that Skia does not always fully decompress first is also supported: "Chrome/Skia does not always decompress the full image and scale it afterward."

claims.claim_text: 一張 2000×2000 的 JPEG 要顯示成 20×20，完整解壓大約要 12 MB，而最終畫面只需要約 1.2 KB
claims.evidence: A bitmap of the full image uses roughly 12 MB, while the final 20 × 20 image needs only about 1.2 KB.
claims.note: Both figures and the 2000×2000 → 20×20 framing match; the post preserves the source's "roughly/about" hedging with 大約/約.

claims.claim_text: 同一張 15 像素的 JPEG logo，在 Chrome 裡看起來比 Firefox 粗，也比較不忠於原圖
claims.evidence: It was rendered at 15px; here is an upscaled version. … On the left, Firefox; on the right, Chrome. … If you squint, or take a step back, the one from Chrome looks thicker.
claims.note: 15px, the Firefox/Chrome side-by-side and "looks thicker" all present. The 「比較不忠於原圖」 half rests on the source's "all the edge softening and gradients were not used"; supported but weaker in the source than in the post's flat phrasing — not meaning-changing.

claims.claim_text: 追蹤 1,867 個 repo 裡 247,694 條 instruction 的生命週期
claims.evidence: we characterize this phenomenon across 247,694 instruction lifetimes in 1,867 repositories
claims.note: Both counts exact.

claims.claim_text: 量到 agentic prompt 檔在整段生命週期成長超過三倍，平均每次 commit 淨增 4.9 條
claims.evidence: agentic prompts grow without bound, more than tripling over their lifetime (+226%), gaining +4.9 net instructions every commit
claims.note: 「超過三倍」 = "more than tripling"; +4.9 net per commit exact.

claims.claim_text: 指令越老越不容易被刪，論文給的 log-hazard 是每個 commit 減 0.032
claims.evidence: the older an instruction gets, the less likely it is to be deleted (log-hazard -0.032/commit)
claims.note: Direction and figure both match.

claims.claim_text: 對照實驗把「為什麼要有這條」寫成註解之後，超額成長從 211.3% 掉到 1.4%，論文並回報真實情境下的 instruction-following 最多改善 23.1%
claims.evidence: comments encoding latent reasoning remove 99.3% of excess instructions (+211.3% to +1.4%) … prompt comments can improve real-world agentic instruction-following by up to 23.1%
claims.note: Numbers exact. The post's 「最多改善」 correctly preserves the source's "up to"; 「對照實驗」 slightly compresses the source's IFEval-inversion setup but does not overstate it.

claims.claim_text: 作者把成因叫作 catastrophic remembering，也就是 catastrophic forgetting 的反面
claims.evidence: We name the resulting divergence catastrophic remembering, the inverse of catastrophic forgetting around which continual learning is organized.
claims.note: Naming and the "inverse of catastrophic forgetting" gloss both from the abstract.

claims.claim_text: Tailscale 半年內遇上 19 次資料庫損毀
claims.evidence: 19 separate instances of database corruption over six months
claims.note: Count and window exact.

claims.claim_text: 而那段程式碼已經在那裡大約十六年
claims.location: item #03 lede (and H2 title「19 次損毀，指向十六年前的競態」)
claims.evidence: the SQLite developers named this the 'WAL-Reset bug', and they estimate it was present in SQLite for at least 16 years
claims.note: Source says "at least 16 years" (a floor); post says 「大約十六年」 (approximately). Not an inflation — if anything it understates the source — and the figure itself is right, so no action. Worth noting for a future copy pass.

claims.claim_text: 「如果寫入發生在 checkpoint 期間的某個特定時機，checkpoint 的處理流程會搞混——它以為某些 page 已經從 WAL 複製進主資料庫檔案，其實並沒有」
claims.evidence: If a write occurs at a specific time during a checkpoint, the checkpointing process gets confused—it thinks some of the pages have been copied from the WAL into the main database file, but they haven't.
claims.note: Translation is faithful clause-for-clause, including the em-dash structure.

claims.claim_text: 會被踩到，是因為他們為了跑快而一致的備份自己接管了 checkpoint
claims.evidence: we take manual control of the checkpoint process so we can run fast and consistent backups … They also explained why we were more likely to hit the bug than other SQLite users: we take manual control of the checkpointing process, and we checkpoint very aggressively.
claims.note: The causal link is the source's own (attributed to the SQLite developers), and 「為了跑快而一致的備份」 maps to "fast and consistent backups".

claims.claim_text: 診斷的突破口是 SQLite 開發者寫出來的 tmstmpvfs shim，一層用來追蹤資料庫操作的 VFS 包裝
claims.evidence: To help diagnose our problem, the SQLite developers created a wrapper around the virtual filesystem that writes additional tracing information and logs about changes to the database. This wrapper is called the `tmstmpvfs` shim
claims.note: Attribution to "the SQLite developers" (not a named individual) matches the post's 「SQLite 開發者」.

claims.claim_text: 它只需要一次乘上預先算好的 10 的冪，「而經典 Schubfach 需要兩次或三次」
claims.evidence: The whole algorithm runs on fixed-width integer arithmetic and uses only one multiplication by a precomputed power of 10, where classic Schubfach needs two or three.
claims.note: Quoted clause is a direct rendering of the source's "where classic Schubfach needs two or three".

claims.claim_text: 省下來的關鍵在半個 ulp 的容差帶：它直接重用同一次乘法的結果再位移得到，因此不必再做額外的 192 位元乘法
claims.evidence: δ doesn't need its own multiplication … so δ is just p₁₀ shifted by an integer (no rounding, no second multiplication). Schubfach instead multiplies v, v_l, and v_r by p₁₀ separately, which is two extra 192-bit multiplications.
claims.note: Reuse-and-shift mechanism and the avoided 192-bit multiplications both present.

claims.claim_text: 這個實作沒有論文，「在 JSON 效能圈以外幾乎沒有公開能見度」，即使它是目前最快的 dtoa 實作之一
claims.evidence: It has no paper, no name beyond the file it lives in … and almost no public profile outside the JSON performance crowd. … It also happens to be one of the fastest dtoa implementations
claims.note: The superlative is correctly kept as 「之一」 / "one of the fastest", not "the fastest".

claims.claim_text: OpenSSH 10.5 在 8 月 11 日發布
claims.evidence: OpenSSH 10.5 … released August 11, 2026
claims.note: Version and date match the release notes page.

claims.claim_text: ssh-agent 上鎖時沒有拒絕 session-bind 請求
claims.evidence: ssh-agent(1): fix an interaction between agent locking and the session-bind@openssh.com extension that is used to identify forwarded agents. These binding requests were refused when the agent was locked, with the result that operations that were intended to be limited to local use only could be performed remotely, including the ability to add PKCS#11 tokens and make use of keys that had destination restrictions applied.
claims.note: The post inverts the bug. The release notes say the binding requests WERE refused while the agent was locked, and that this refusal is what let supposedly local-only operations be performed remotely. The post asserts the opposite ('沒有拒絕' = did not refuse). Contradicted by the cited source.

claims.claim_text: 公告寫明「OpenSSH 團隊目前將更頻繁地發布版本，讓 bugfix 更快到使用者手上，而不是把它們累積到下一個計畫中的版本」
claims.evidence: making more frequent releases to get bugfixes into users' hands more quickly rather than batching them until the next planned release
claims.note: Translation faithful, including 「累積到下一個計畫中的版本」 for "batching them until the next planned release".

claims.claim_text: 團隊同時表明歡迎 AI 產出的回報，尤其是「搭配人工分流、分析、測試案例，特別是附上建議修正的時候」
claims.evidence: we very much welcome these reports, especially when combined with human triage, analysis, test-cases and particularly when accompanied by proposed fixes
claims.note: Clause-for-clause match.

claims.claim_text: 只按 prefix locality 排程會讓混合比例走鐘
claims.evidence: Prefix-aware routing improves inference efficiency through cache reuse and load balancing, but it does not control how heterogeneous rollout sessions compete for KV-cache capacity. … Rollout scheduling must account for this heterogeneity without distorting the workload mixture specified by the trainer.
claims.note: The abstract says prefix-aware routing 'does not control' KV-cache competition — an absence of control. The post upgrades this into an active causal failure ('會讓混合比例走鐘' = causes the mixture to skew), a claim the source never makes about prefix-locality scheduling. Meaning-changing inflation of a hedged/limited statement.

claims.claim_text: 論文回報相對於調校過的 vLLM Router，在 Step3.7 與 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上分別多出 53.3% 與 43.6% 吞吐
claims.evidence: In rollout-only ablations on Step3.7 and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MISA-T improves rollout throughput over a sweep-tuned cache-aware vLLM Router by 53.3% and 43.6%, respectively, while maintaining high prefix-cache hit rates.
claims.note: Model names, baseline ('sweep-tuned' → 「調校過的」) and both percentages match.

claims.claim_text: 50 次迭代的對照實驗裡 rollout 吞吐增加 35.6%，平均迭代時間降低 22.8%
claims.evidence: 50-iteration Step3.7 experiment: rollout throughput increased by 35.6%, mean iteration time reduced by 22.8%
claims.note: Both figures and the 50-iteration framing match the abstract's end-to-end result.

claims.claim_text: MISA-T 把決策搬到 routing 層做 admission，依 workload 分配 KV-cache 容量，並以 residency-time-aware 的方式記帳，同時把實際消耗掉的混合比例維持在 trainer 指定的目標附近
claims.evidence: routing-layer admission policy for mixed rollout serving … combines adaptive session admission, workload-aware KV-capacity allocation, and residency-time-aware KV accounting … keeping the consumed workload mixture close to the trainer target
claims.note: All four components map one-to-one onto the abstract's description.

claims.claim_text: 「在一本十億頁的帳本裡，Bob 不必往回翻完十億頁，最多只需要檢視 30 頁」
claims.evidence: In a ledger with a billion pages, instead of flipping backwards (in the worst case) through all billion pages, Bob only needs to examine 30 different pages at most to find Alice's address.
claims.note: Faithful translation of the analogy including the 'at most 30' bound.

claims.claim_text: 稽核由 Cloudflare 與 Trail of Bits 對每筆 log 條目簽章，讓伺服器沒辦法同時維持多本不一致的帳本
claims.evidence: Cloudflare and Trail of Bits … sign that ledger page and index book, indicating that the record was added correctly … prevents a compromised server operator from maintaining multiple divergent versions of the directory
claims.note: Both auditor names and the split-view-prevention property are the source's own. Single-source (Signal's blog) but the prose attributes it as Signal's design, not as independent confirmation.

claims.claim_text: 公開識別碼會先過一層 verifiable random function，它們對應到的值再用 keyed hash function 保護
claims.evidence: Public identifiers are processed through a verifiable random function and the values they map to are protected by a keyed hash function
claims.note: Both primitives and which side each applies to match exactly.

claims.claim_text: 「模型與它處理的訊息資料全都留在裝置上」，而且 WhatsApp 沒有辦法在使用者沒動作的情況下主動送出任何資料
claims.evidence: The model and the message data it processes all remain on the device. … WhatsApp is unable to initiate sharing of any user data without the user's action.
claims.note: Both halves are verbatim-equivalent to the source's own guarantees.

claims.claim_text: 每個模型版本上線前先雜湊並公布到第三方的 append-only ledger，由 Cloudflare 而非 Meta 用 Ed25519 簽章
claims.evidence: Every model version — including its SHA-256 hash — is published on a third-party append-only transparency ledger before it is served to anyone. … Cloudflare signs the manifest using Ed25519 keys. Meta does not hold signing keys.
claims.note: The 'Cloudflare 而非 Meta' contrast is explicit in the source.

claims.claim_text: 用戶端要比對 manifest digest 與 SHA-256 才肯載入，任何一項對不上就拒絕
claims.evidence: Cross-references manifest digest with transparency ledger … Verifies SHA-256 hashes of downloaded assets match the manifest … If any step fails, the client refuses to load the model.
claims.note: Both comparisons and the fail-closed behaviour are the source's.

claims.claim_text: 回傳的統計則先在裝置上聚合，走 OHTTP relay 剝掉 IP，再進 TEE 處理，最後加上差分隱私雜訊與 k-匿名門檻
claims.evidence: routed through a third-party OHTTP relay that strips the requester's IP address … Metrics processed within Trusted Execution Environments running attested binaries … Only anonymous, differentially private aggregates are made available to Meta and WhatsApp, with k-anonymity thresholds enforced before data release.
claims.note: All four pipeline stages present in the source and in the same order.

claims.claim_text: 「如果你需要雙向、低延遲的通訊（聊天、協作、遊戲），用 WebSocket；如果只是從伺服器推播，SSE 更簡單、營運成本也更低」
claims.evidence: If you need bidirectional, low-latency communication (chat, collaboration, games), WebSocket; if you only push from the server, SSE is simpler and cheaper to operate.
claims.note: Verbatim translation, parenthetical examples included. The 「同一張表上比較」 framing is also supported: the comparison table lists htmx (HTTP + extensions) and Datastar (SSE) alongside the WebSocket frameworks.

claims.claim_text: 作者說自己的網站在類似 Raspberry Pi 3 的硬體上撐過 600 位同時上線的讀者
claims.evidence: handled peaks of 600 simultaneous readers without trouble, running on hardware similar to a Raspberry Pi 3 with other services running alongside
claims.note: Figure, hardware and the 「作者說」 attribution all match; the post correctly marks it as the author's own report.

claims.claim_text: 每個 client 在伺服器端對應一個帶狀態的行程…狀態放在記憶體裡，水平擴展就得共用狀態，連線一斷應用就停擺
claims.evidence: a process per connected client that remembers where it is … it keeps a WebSocket open and, usually, each client's state in memory … forces you to share that state (in Django, with Channels + an ASGI server + Redis) … If the connection drops, the site stops working.
claims.note: All three stated tradeoffs are the source's own caveats.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic 公布一個未發布的研究版 Claude 把 zeta 函式零點落在臨界線上的比例下界，從 41.6% 推到 67.2%
claims.evidence: An unreleased research version of Claude has improved on a longstanding lower bound for the fraction of zeros of the Riemann zeta function … increased this bound from 41.6% to 67.2%
claims.note: Both bounds and the 'unreleased research version' qualifier are carried over intact.

claims.claim_text: 過程是兩次 Claude Code session、3,100 萬個 output token，前段丟掉 650 個失敗的想法，後段由 60 個 subagent 協作跑了 2,400 個 shell 指令與數百支 Python 腳本，大約 36 小時
claims.evidence: Initially, Claude generated and tried 650 ideas, none of which worked. Jarred prompted Claude to try again, and it spent a day and a half coordinating about 60 Claude subagents … they ran 2,400 shell commands and wrote hundreds of Python scripts … 31 million output tokens
claims.note: Every figure checks out, and the post correctly places the 650 ideas in the first session and the subagent run (a day and a half = ~36 hours) in the second. Minor: source says 'about 60 subagents'; post drops the 'about'.

claims.claim_text: 結果由數學家 Levent Alpöge 與 Ralph Furman 驗證
claims.evidence: Levent Alpöge and Ralph Furman, two of Anthropic's own mathematicians, examined Claude's work to understand the new results and how they related to the prior work mentioned above.
claims.note: Two drifts, both raising credibility. (1) The source says they 'examined Claude's work to understand the new results' — not that they verified or checked it; the article never uses verified/verification/checked of either name. (2) The post drops 'Anthropic's own', so an in-house review reads as external validation. The source's actual external readers are Brian Conrey and Dan Goldston, who 'generously examined the paper on short notice' and are not named in the post.

claims.claim_text: 證明也用 Lean 形式化過
claims.evidence: Claude worked with another member of staff, Eric Easley, to produce a Lean formalization of the result, which passes the standard validation tool comparator.
claims.note: Lean formalization confirmed; the post's passive phrasing does not overclaim who did it.

claims.claim_text: 官方給的說法是這顯示 AI 模型「能以新的、有時令人意外的方式，延伸數學家想法的影響力與觸及範圍」
claims.evidence: AI models like Claude can extend the impact and reach of mathematicians' ideas in new and sometimes surprising ways
claims.note: Faithful translation; 「官方給的說法」 correctly attributes it to Anthropic rather than presenting it as the checker's or author's conclusion.
